nodes.label: Lesson items page — search, filters, practice stats, favorites
nodes.rationale: Chose a sparse lesson_item_attrs table keyed by (owner_id, norm_key) over full normalization into a words table, because normalizing would force a get-or-create onto the offline-sync-critical write path (upsertLessonItems), the riskiest code in the repo. Chose jsonb categories over an EAV table since category filtering had no consumer yet.

nodes.label: SetItemFavoriteOp (proposed, phase 2)
nodes.rationale: Proposed as last-write-wins by client timestamp rather than upsert-by-id, since replaying 'favorite=true' twice is naturally a no-op and the server applies it only if at >= lesson_item_attrs.updated_at — a genuinely new convergence rule versus the three existing idempotent-upsert ops.

nodes.label: Lesson items page search/filters/stats/favorites (doc, referenced)
nodes.rationale: URL-as-filter-state design that R2's items-query grammar extraction formalizes.
